wholePhysicalScope: The 18-point native outer rim maps the complete standing building. Heritage descriptions establish historic palace and modern wing. The junction and internal openings are interpreted.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the historic palace, its recessed garden arcade and attached museum extension. Near views refine the porch and projecting timber windows.
limitations: The overall mapped envelope is controlling. The exact old and new boundary, roof heights, courtyard and skylight placement, porch dimensions, rear elevations and foundation levels are estimated.
The contemporary exterior is represented using the mapped geometry and written building descriptions. No contemporary extension imagery was used.
Only the museum exterior is represented. The adjacent Assembly, Bey’s Mosque, sculpture, inscriptions, public art, landscape and interiors are outside the modeled scope.
